verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਕੂਆ ਖੋਦਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੋਇ ਰੋਇ ਪਛੁਤਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ghar laagai aag jaag kooaa khodhayo chaahai kaaraj na sidh hoi roi pachhutaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as while sleeping, someone's house catches fire and he wakes up and starts digging well, he cannot succeed in putting off the fire. Instead, he then repents and cries.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤੌ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਸੀਖਿਯੋ ਚਾਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬਿਦਯਾ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਉਦਮ ਜੈਤ ਪਦਵੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau sa(n)graam samai seekhiyo chaahai beer bidhayaa anithaa udham jait padhavee na paieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as someone wants to learn the art of warfare when the battle is in progress, it is a futile effort. Victory cannot be achieved.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਸੰਗਾਤੀ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ  ਪਾਛੇ ਭੋਰ ਭਏ ਭਾਰ ਬਾਂਧ ਚਲੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nis sovat sa(n)gaatee chal jaat  paachhe bhor bhe bhaar baa(n)dh chale kat jaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Just as a traveller goes to sleep at night and all his companions proceed further leaving him behind, then where will he go with all his luggage when the day breaks?

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਾਯਾ ਧੰਧ ਅੰਧ ਅਵਧਿ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਜਾਇ ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੪੯੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise maayaa dha(n)dh a(n)dh avadh bihai jai a(n)t kaal kaise har naam liv laieeaai ||495||

en.bdb: Similarly, an ignorant man entangled in worldly love and attachments, spends his life accumulating wealth. How can he engross his mind in the name of the Lord when he is on his last breaths?  (495)
